candidate_contract.source_document: PHASE-G.md, 'Remaining work: all of it blocked on the pilot' (Stage 2, step 1)
provenance_sources: authored for the Phase G Stage 2 screen, from the official BNS-to-IPC corresponding section table

yield.unit_note: majority_rate is the planning quantity: a target population needs items whose *majority* answer is correct, not items with at least one correct sample.

projection.note: a zero observed rate cannot be projected; a zero would be indistinguishable from an even lower unobserved rate

projection_basis: a usable two-class evaluation population needs enough correct items for an AUROC interval to be meaningful; 15 is the planning floor used for the Phase G cost estimate and is NOT a threshold from the engineering guide
verdict_note: This is a yield estimate, not a gate. A zero rate means no two-class population can be built from this item set with this generator; it does not license changing any Phase E/F constant.
